title: Record the stage-2 break-even offset
body:
## Summary
- Each of the five printed stage-2 extraction margins equals the negation of its price minus 2,091,300.
- The two prices, −2,101,683 and −2,106,679, and the two margins, 10,383 and 15,379, differ by 4,996. The five prices sum to −10,523,403.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
